summary: Forensic evaluation of 5 disputed location classifications comparing captured bank source evidence against benchmark annotations and engine behavior.

cases.title: Everton Holidays (Pvt) Ltd
cases.scrapedDescription: 25% Discount at Everton Holidays Boutique Villas for Sampath Mastercard and Visa Credit Cardholders.
cases.sourceEvidenceExcerpt:
Title: "Everton Holidays (Pvt) Ltd" | Promo: "25% Discount at Everton Holidays Boutique Villas for Sampath Mastercard and Visa Credit Cardholders." | Terms: "terms_and_conditions":"1. The offer will be valid only for all Sampath Mastercard and Visa Credit Cardholders.(Excluding corporate cards).
\n
\"
cases.evidenceAnalysis: The bank promotion provides zero branch locations, street addresses, or property names. Reservations are explicitly conducted exclusively by phone ("calling the central reservations"). The original benchmark assumed a single villa exists without source evidence.
cases.consumerUxSafetyImpact: If marked SINGLE_BRANCH, Lanka Offers would fabricate a false map pin or single-venue assumption when cardholders must call central reservations for boutique villa bookings.
cases.invariantAdherence: Satisfies Invariant #4: Zero false location precision; no fabricated coordinates or scope assertions.

cases.title: AMANTE
cases.scrapedDescription: 25% off for Credit Cards & 10% off Debit Cards on total bill
cases.sourceEvidenceExcerpt: Title: "AMANTE" | General Terms: ["Maximum transaction limit Rs.50,000/-","Offer valid only for one transaction per card during the promotion period","General terms and conditions apply.","Valid at below outlets only"] | Raw HTML terms: "Valid at below outlets only: 1. Racecourse Mall, 2. Marino Mall, 3. KCC, 4. Nugegoda, 5. Negombo, 6. OGF, 7. CCC, 8. Kirula Rd, 9. Majestic City"
cases.evidenceAnalysis: The bank terms explicitly restrict participation with "Valid at below outlets only". Although the raw page enumerates 9 outlets, the scraper failed to populate merchant.addresses. The benchmark author lazily assigned NATIONWIDE based on the retail brand reputation, directly contradicting the bank's outlet restriction.
cases.consumerUxSafetyImpact: If marked NATIONWIDE, cardholders would be misled into visiting non-participating outlets or airport/franchise stores where the bank promotion is denied.
cases.invariantAdherence: Satisfies Invariant #4: Zero false location precision; no fabricated coordinates or scope assertions.

cases.scrapedDescription: 20% discount on total bill for NDB Mastercard Credit Cards. Minimum transaction Rs. 4,000.
cases.sourceEvidenceExcerpt: Merchant: "Keells Super" | Location: "Colombo" | Addresses: ["Colombo, Sri Lanka"] | Desc: "20% discount on total bill for NDB Mastercard Credit Cards. Minimum transaction Rs. 4,000."
cases.evidenceAnalysis: The candidate record specifies merchant.location = "Colombo" and merchant.addresses = ["Colombo, Sri Lanka"]. The benchmark assigned MULTI_BRANCH because Keells Super is an islandwide chain of 130+ supermarkets. However, this specific campaign record was explicitly bound to Colombo.
cases.consumerUxSafetyImpact: If marked MULTI_BRANCH without branch list, consumers outside Colombo would expect supermarket discounts at outstation branches.
cases.invariantAdherence: Satisfies Invariant #4: Zero false location precision; no fabricated coordinates or scope assertions.

cases.consumerUxSafetyImpact: If marked MULTI_BRANCH, the system would assert multiple participating venues exist without knowing whether all Delifrance outlets (e.g. OGF, Crescat, Kandy) participate.
